CREATE TABLE [dbo].[T_EMC_EMP] (
  [ID] varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  [USERNAME] varchar(64) NULL,
  [BIRTHDAY] date NULL,
  [AGE] decimal(5) NULL,
  [ORGID] varchar(32) NULL,
  [ORGNAME] varchar(256) NULL,
  [MOBILE] varchar(32) NULL,
  [SEX] varchar(32) NULL,
  [FILTERTEST] varchar(32) NULL,
  [PHONE] varchar(32) NULL,
  [NATION] varchar(32) NULL,
  [STARTWORKDATE] date NULL,
  [TITLEDATE] date NULL,
  [PROFESSIONALTITLE] varchar(32) NULL,
  [POSITION] varchar(32) NULL,
  [REMARK] varchar(512) NULL,
  [ELECTRONICSIGNATURE] varchar(256) NULL,
  [PIC] varchar(256) NULL,
  [CREATEDBYID] varchar(32) NULL,
  [CREATEDBYNAME] varchar(64) NULL,
  [CREATEDTIME] datetime NULL,
  [CREATEDBYORGID] varchar(32) NULL,
  [CREATEDBYORGNAME] varchar(256) NULL
)

CREATE TABLE [dbo].[T_EMC_CONTAINER_CATEGORY] (
[ID] varchar(16)  NOT NULL ,
[CONTAINERCATEGORYNAME] varchar(64)  NULL ,
[FIXER] varchar(64)  NULL ,
[CAPACITY] varchar(16)  NULL ,
[COLOR] varchar(16)  NULL ,
[MATERIAL] varchar(64)  NULL ,
[SAMPLEBOTTLECALIBER] varchar(32)  NULL ,
[BOTTLENECKPROCESS] varchar(16)  NULL ,
[CREATEDBYID] varchar(32)  NULL ,
[CREATEDBYNAME] varchar(64)  NULL ,
[CREATEDTIME] datetime NULL ,
[CREATEDBYORGID] varchar(32)  NULL ,
[CREATEDBYORGNAME] varchar(256)  NULL ,
CONSTRAINT [PK_T_EMC_CONTAINER_CATEGORY_ID] PRIMARY KEY ([ID])
)
ON [PRIMARY]
GO

IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) from fn_listextendedproperty('MS_Description',
'SCHEMA', N'dbo',
'TABLE', N'T_EMC_CONTAINER_CATEGORY',
'COLUMN', N'ID')) > 0)
EXEC sp_updateextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'容器类型编码'
, @level0type = 'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo'
, @level1type = 'TABLE', @level1name = N'T_EMC_CONTAINER_CATEGORY'
, @level2type = 'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ID'
ELSE
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'容器类型编码'
, @level0type = 'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo'
, @level1type = 'TABLE', @level1name = N'T_EMC_CONTAINER_CATEGORY'
, @level2type = 'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ID'
GO

IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) from fn_listextendedproperty('MS_Description',
'SCHEMA', N'dbo',
'TABLE', N'T_EMC_CONTAINER_CATEGORY',

CREATE TABlE DBO.T_EMC_CERT(
    ID INT NOT NULL,
     EMPID VARCHAR(32)  NOT NULL,
     CERTNO VARCHAR(32)  NULL ,
     CERTNAME VARCHAR(64)  NULL ,
     AUTHDATE DATETIME NULL ,
     EXPIREDATE DATETIME NULL ,
     WARNINGDAYS INT NULL ,
     STATUS INT NULL ,
     ORDERNO INT NULL ,
     CREATEDBYID VARCHAR(32)  NULL ,
     CREATEDBYNAME VARCHAR(64)  NULL ,
     CREATEDTIME DATETIME NULL ,
     CREATEDBYORGID VARCHAR(32)  NULL ,
     CREATEDBYORGNAME VARCHAR(256)  NULL ,
 CONSTRAINT PK_EMC_CERT PRIMARY KEY(ID));

[ID] varchar(15)  NOT NULL ,

[TEMPERATURE] varchar(30)  NULL ,
[ANALYSISBEGINDATE] datetime NULL ,
[ANALYSISBEGINTIME] varchar(18)  NULL ,
[ANALYSISENDDATE] datetime NULL ,
[ANALYSISENDTIME] varchar(18)  NULL ,
[RECEIVEDATE] datetime NULL ,
[RECEIVETIME] varchar(18)  NULL ,
[HANDLEDATE] datetime NULL ,
[HANDLEMETHOD] varchar(30)  NULL ,
[BEFOREHANDLE] varchar(66)  NULL ,
[METHODPARAM] varchar(66)  NULL ,
[ANALYSISUSERID] varchar(30)  NULL ,
[ANALYSISUSERNAME] varchar(60)  NULL ,
[PARTAKEUSERID] varchar(240)  NULL ,
[PARTAKEUSERNAME] varchar(480)  NULL ,
[ASSISTEQUIPTID] bigint NULL ,
[EQUIPTID] bigint NULL ,
[CALIBRATIONCURVE] varchar(240)  NULL ,
[ORDERCATEGORY] varchar(60)  NULL ,
[CHECKUSERID] varchar(30)  NULL ,
[CHECKUSERNAME] varchar(60)  NULL ,
[TESTMETHODID] bigint NULL ,
[TESTNAME] varchar(36)  NULL ,
[CREATEDBYID] varchar(33)  NULL ,
[CREATEDBYNAME] varchar(66)  NULL ,
[CREATEDTIME] datetime NULL ,
[CREATEDBYORGID] varchar(33)  NULL ,
[CREATEDBYORGNAME] varchar(255)  NULL
)
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[T_EMC_RUN] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_EMC_RUN] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID])
WITH (PAD_INDEX = OFF, STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF, ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS = ON, ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS = ON)
ON [PRIMARY]
GO

'SCHEMA', N'dbo',
'TABLE', N'T_EMC_RUN',
'COLUMN', N'ID')) > 0)
EXEC sp_updateextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'批号'
, @level0type = 'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo'
, @level1type = 'TABLE', @level1name = N'T_EMC_RUN'
, @level2type = 'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ID'
ELSE
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'批号'
, @level0type = 'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo'
, @level1type = 'TABLE', @level1name = N'T_EMC_RUN'
, @level2type = 'COLUMN', @level2name = N'ID'
GO

'SCHEMA', N'dbo',
'TABLE', N'T_EMC_RUN',
'COLUMN', N'HUMIDITY')) > 0)
EXEC sp_updateextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'湿度'
, @level0type = 'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo'
, @level1type = 'TABLE', @level1name = N'T_EMC_RUN'
, @level2type = 'COLUMN', @level2name = N'HUMIDITY'
ELSE
EXEC sp_addextendedproperty @name = N'MS_Description', @value = N'湿度'
, @level0type = 'SCHEMA', @level0name = N'dbo'
, @level1type = 'TABLE', @level1name = N'T_EMC_RUN'
, @level2type = 'COLUMN', @level2name = N'HUMIDITY'
GO

-- ----------------------------- 2019-11-03 add by yuanhh--------------begin
UPDATE T_EMC_METHOD
   SET MAXVERSIONID =
       (SELECT MAX(ID) FROM T_EMC_METHOD_VERSION WHERE METHODID = T_EMC_METHOD.ID GROUP BY METHODID),
       MAXVERSIONNO =
       (SELECT MAX(VERSIONNO) FROM T_EMC_METHOD_VERSION WHERE METHODID = T_EMC_METHOD.ID GROUP BY METHODID);

UPDATE T_EMC_METHOD
   SET TESTMETHODBASIS =
       (SELECT TESTMETHODBASIS FROM T_EMC_METHOD_VERSION WHERE ID=T_EMC_METHOD.MAXVERSIONID),
       MAXELNTMPLID =
       (SELECT ELNTMPLID FROM T_EMC_METHOD_VERSION WHERE ID=T_EMC_METHOD.MAXVERSIONID);

-- ----------------------------- 2019-11-12 add by zhanghang--------------begin
CREATE proc [dbo].[P_GETELNDSSQL_ORDERTASK](@IN_RUNID VARCHAR(16),@OUT_ELNSQL VARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT)
AS
BEGIN
		DECLARE @ITEMALIASNAME VARCHAR(MAX);
		--声明一个游标查询分析项名称
		DECLARE CUR_ITEMALIASNAMES CURSOR
		FOR
		SELECT DISTINCT OTR.ITEMALIASNAME
				FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT, T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT OTR
				WHERE OT.ID = OTR.ORDERTASKID AND OT.RUNID = @IN_RUNID AND OTR.REPEATNO = 1;
		--打开游标
		OPEN CUR_ITEMALIASNAMES;
		--从游标里取出数据赋值到我们刚才声明的2个变量中
		FETCH NEXT FROM CUR_ITEMALIASNAMES INTO @ITEMALIASNAME;

		SET @OUT_ELNSQL = 'SELECT O.ORDERNO ''样品编号'', ';
		--判断游标的状态
		-- 0 fetch语句成功
		---1 fetch语句失败或此行不在结果集中
		---2 被提取的行不存在
		WHILE ( @@fetch_status = 0 )
				BEGIN
						--显示出每次用游标取出的值
						print (@ITEMALIASNAME)
						SET @OUT_ELNSQL = @OUT_ELNSQL + 'MAX(CASE OTR.ITEMALIASNAME WHEN ''' +
															@ITEMALIASNAME +
															''' THEN OTR.REPORTRESULT ELSE NULL END ) ' +
															'''' +
															@ITEMALIASNAME + ''',';

						SET @OUT_ELNSQL = @OUT_ELNSQL +
															'MAX(CASE OTR.ITEMALIASNAME WHEN ''' +
															@ITEMALIASNAME +
															''' THEN OTR.ID ELSE NULL END ) ' +
															'''' +
															@ITEMALIASNAME +
															'_RID'',';
						--用游标去取下一条记录
						FETCH NEXT FROM CUR_ITEMALIASNAMES INTO @ITEMALIASNAME;
				END;
		--关闭游标
		CLOSE CUR_ITEMALIASNAMES;

		--撤销游标
		DEALLOCATE CUR_ITEMALIASNAMES;
		SET @OUT_ELNSQL = SUBSTRING(@OUT_ELNSQL,1,LEN(@OUT_ELNSQL)-1);
		SET @OUT_ELNSQL = @OUT_ELNSQL +
		' FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT,T_EMC_ORDER_TASK_RESULT OTR,T_EMC_ORDER O WHERE OT.ID = OTR.ORDERTASKID AND OT.ORDERID = O.ID AND OT.RUNID = ''' +
		@IN_RUNID +
		''' AND OTR.REPEATNO =1 GROUP BY O.ORDERNO';
		print(@OUT_ELNSQL);
		IF(CHARINDEX(',  FROM T_EMC_ORDER_TASK OT',@OUT_ELNSQL)>0)
			BEGIN
				SET @OUT_ELNSQL = NULL;
			END
END;
GO

NEXT VALUE FOR SEQ_CORE,
A.ID,
B.MONITORPOINTTYPE
FROM
    T_EMC_MONITOR_POINT A
    LEFT JOIN T_EMC_MONITOR_POINT_CATEGORY B ON A.MONITORPOINTCATEGORYID = B.ID
    WHERE
    NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT TMPLID, BIZID FROM T_EMC_PROPERTY_DATA C WHERE C.BIZID = A.ID
    )

    ID BIGINT  NOT NULL,
     ASSETCATEGORY VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     ASSETNAME VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     MODEL VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     QUANTITY BIGINT NULL ,
     PRICE decimal(15,4) NULL ,
     TOTALAMOUNT decimal(15,4) NULL ,
     PURCHASETIME DATETIME  NULL ,
     FACTORYNO VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     RESPONSITYORGID VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     USEORGID VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     USEMODIFY VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     STOREPLACE VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     REMARK VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,

     CREATEDTIME DATETIME NULL ,
     CREATEDBYORGID VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     CREATEDBYORGNAME VARCHAR(270)  NULL,
 CONSTRAINT PK_EMC_FIXEDASSET PRIMARY KEY(ID));

CREATE TABlE DBO.T_EMC_MANAGE_REVIEW(
     ID BIGINT  NOT NULL,
     QUALITYCONTROLNO VARCHAR(18)  NULL ,
     REVIEWPURPOSE VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     REVIEWSCOPE VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     REVIEWTIME DATETIME  NULL ,
     PARTAKEUSER VARCHAR(360)  NULL ,
     REVIEWADDRESS VARCHAR(360)  NULL ,
     REVIEWWAY VARCHAR(360)  NULL ,
     REVIEWCONTENT VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     PREPAREWORK VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     REVIEWSTARTTIME DATETIME  NULL ,
     REVIEWENDTIME DATETIME  NULL ,
     REVIEWBASIS VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     REVIEWDESC VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     ADVISE VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     REVIEWOPINION VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     YEARTARGET VARCHAR(540)  NULL ,
     REVIEWGROUPUSER VARCHAR(360)  NULL ,
     CREATEDBYID VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     CREATEDBYNAME VARCHAR(60)  NULL ,
     CREATEDTIME DATETIME  NULL ,
     CREATEDBYORGID VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
     CREATEDBYORGNAME VARCHAR(270)  NULL ,
     PROCESSSTATUS VARCHAR(36)  NULL
 CONSTRAINT PK_EMC_MANAGE_REVIEW PRIMARY KEY(ID));
EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty @name=N'MS_Description', @value=N'管理评审计划' , @level0type=N'SCHEMA', @level0name=N'dbo', @level1type=N'TABLE',@level1name=N'T_EMC_MANAGE_REVIEW';
EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty @name=N'MS_Description', @value=N'主键' , @level0type=N'SCHEMA', @level0name=N'dbo', @level1type=N'TABLE',@level1name=N'T_EMC_MANAGE_REVIEW', @level2type=N'COLUMN',@level2name=N'id';

EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty @name=N'MS_Description', @value=N'质控编号' , @level0type=N'SCHEMA', @level0name=N'dbo', @level1type=N'TABLE',@level1name=N'T_EMC_MANAGE_REVIEW', @level2type=N'COLUMN',@level2name=N'qualityControlNo';

EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty @name=N'MS_Description', @value=N'评审目的' , @level0type=N'SCHEMA', @level0name=N'dbo', @level1type=N'TABLE',@level1name=N'T_EMC_MANAGE_REVIEW', @level2type=N'COLUMN',@level2name=N'reviewPurpose';

EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty @name=N'MS_Description', @value=N'评审范围' , @level0type=N'SCHEMA', @level0name=N'dbo', @level1type=N'TABLE',@level1name=N'T_EMC_MANAGE_REVIEW', @level2type=N'COLUMN',@level2name=N'reviewScope';

EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty @name=N'MS_Description', @value=N'拟计划评审时间' , @level0type=N'SCHEMA', @level0name=N'dbo', @level1type=N'TABLE',@level1name=N'T_EMC_MANAGE_REVIEW', @level2type=N'COLUMN',@level2name=N'reviewTime';

)

CREATE TABLE dbo.T_EMC_PRECAUTION (
  ID BIGINT NOT NULL,
  PRECAUTECODE VARCHAR(18) DEFAULT NULL,
  SOURCE VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  SOURCENO VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  IMPLEMENTORGNAME VARCHAR(270) DEFAULT NULL,
  IMPLEMENTLEADER VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT NULL,
  PARTAKEUSER VARCHAR(300) DEFAULT NULL,
  REASION VARCHAR(540) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRECAUTION VARCHAR(540) DEFAULT NULL,
  VERIFYMETHOD VARCHAR(540) DEFAULT NULL,
  COMPLETEDATE DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
  VERIFYUSER VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDBYID VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDBYNAME VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDBYORGID VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDBYORGNAME VARCHAR(270) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDTIME DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
  PROCESSSTATUS VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE T_EMC_CORRECTION (
  ID BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CORRECTIONCODE VARCHAR(18) DEFAULT NULL,
  SOURCE VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  SOURCENO VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  FACTDESCRIPTION VARCHAR(540) DEFAULT NULL,
  BASIS VARCHAR(540) DEFAULT NULL,
  RESPONSIBLEORGNAME VARCHAR(270) DEFAULT NULL,
  RESPONSIBLELEADER VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT NULL,
  DISCOVERDATE DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
  DISCOVERUSER VARCHAR(300) DEFAULT NULL,
  CORRECTION VARCHAR(540) DEFAULT NULL,
  COMPLETESITUATION VARCHAR(540) DEFAULT NULL,
  VERIFYRESULT VARCHAR(540) DEFAULT NULL,
  COMPLETEDATETIME DATE DEFAULT NULL,
  VERIFYUSER VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDBYID VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDBYNAME VARCHAR(60) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDBYORGID VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDBYORGNAME VARCHAR(270) DEFAULT NULL,
  CREATEDTIME DATETIME DEFAULT NULL,
  PROCESSSTATUS VARCHAR(36) DEFAULT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE [T_EMC_FETCH_DATA] (
[ID] bigint NOT NULL,
[TABLENAME] varchar(66) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[FIELDONE] bigint NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[FIELDTWO] bigint NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[FIELDTHREE] bigint NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[FIELDONENAME] varchar(66) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[FIELDTWONAME] varchar(66) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[FIELDTHREENAME] varchar(66) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[CREATEDBYID] varchar(36) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[CREATEDBYNAME] varchar(60) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[CREATEDTIME] datetime2(0) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[CREATEDBYORGID] varchar(36) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[CREATEDBYORGNAME] varchar(255) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[ACTIVATEDFLAG] varchar(1) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[ACTIVATEDBYID] varchar(32) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[ACTIVATEDBYNAME] varchar(64) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
[ACTIVATEDTIME] datetime2(0) NULL DEFAULT NULL,

    ID BIGINT NOT NULL,

    DRAWER VARCHAR(30)  NULL ,
    INVOICEAMOUNT VARCHAR(30)  NULL ,
    CONTRACTID VARCHAR(300)  NULL ,
    CONTRACTNAME VARCHAR(300)  NULL ,
    PROJECTID VARCHAR(300)  NULL ,
    PROJECTNAME VARCHAR(300)  NULL ,
    DONEFLAG VARCHAR(3)  NULL ,
    REMARK VARCHAR(300)  NULL ,
    AUDITUSERID VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
    AUDITUSER VARCHAR(60)  NULL ,
    PROCESSSTATUS VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
    CREATEDBYID VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
    CREATEDBYNAME VARCHAR(60)  NULL ,
    CREATEDTIME DATETIME NULL ,
    CREATEDBYORGID VARCHAR(36)  NULL ,
